consequence.statement: This is a feature addition that provides new functionality; existing configurations and deployments are not affected.

original.statement: Pod log search functionality now supports a case-sensitive matching option.

decision.reason: [ev-42b898158423] lists this commit only under Changelog › Features, as added match-case support in pod log search. That reads as a new optional capability. The evidence says nothing fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or must be migrated, so no failure kind and no behavior-change applies. "none" (informational) is the supported consequence, but the excerpt does not say outright that there is no impact, which is why confidence is low.
